citation: Veiga V. et al. Evaluating the quality of data management plans in health sciences: a study on DMPTool and DMPOnline. Journal of Data Protection and Privacy, v. 12, n. 3, p. 381-395, 2025.
objective_summary: Avaliar a qualidade de planos de gestão de dados elaborados por investigadores na área da saúde e neurociências nas plataformas DMPTool e DMPOnline.
participant_characteristics: Investigadores da área da saúde e neurociências
barriers_reported: Researchers are generally unaware of the importance and usefulness of DMPs, and acknowledge various inconsistencies and challenges in their development.
challenges_reported: DMPs frequently present gaps, incomplete sections, or non-conformity with FAIR principles (approx. 91% error/incompleteness rate).
benefit_factors: melhor organização dos dados; facilitação da reprodutibilidade; aumento do potencial de compartilhamento
contextual_institutional_factors: exigências de financiadores; políticas e normas
facilitators_reported: Recommendation of educational programs, clear guidelines, and institutionalization of data competence centers.
data_sharing_reuse_practices: DMPs must comply with FAIR principles, being as open as possible and as closed as necessary, but compliance is often hindered by lack of training.
usability_user_experience: Tools offer technical ease, but generic templates and lack of domain adaptation create friction in the researcher's workflow.
recommendations_key: Advocate for automating data management and making DMPs machine-actionable (maDMPs), institutionalizing data competence centers.
limitations_flag: Amostra reduzida de inquéritos detalhados, focando-se numa análise exploratória qualitativa de DMPs públicos na saúde.
comments: Estudo S007 validado detalhadamente conforme relatório completo.
